hero_headline: Start your collision repair in Big Bear.
hero_lead: Meet with a Showtime team member, begin vehicle and claim intake, and arrange a rental car on site—without driving to Running Springs first.
review_quote: I’ve taken my car here twice—always go above and beyond. Making my car like it just came out of a dealership. 100% recommend them.
faq1_question: Is Big Bear a full collision repair shop?
faq1_answer: Big Bear is a staffed satellite intake facility. The team can get the process started, collect claim and vehicle information, and help arrange a rental car. Complete repair operations are performed at the Running Springs facility.
faq2_question: Can I get a rental car at the Big Bear location?
faq2_answer: Rental cars are available on site, subject to current availability and rental requirements. Call ahead so the team can help confirm the best plan.
faq3_question: What should I bring to the satellite facility?
faq3_answer: Bring your driver’s license, insurance information, claim number, insurer estimate if you have one, and the vehicle when it is safe to drive.
faq4_question: Can I begin without visiting in person?
faq4_answer: Yes. Use the Carwise photo-estimate flow on a mobile phone, then the team can help determine whether the next step should be the Big Bear satellite or the Running Springs facility.
faq5_question: What if the vehicle is not safe to drive?
faq5_answer: Do not drive a vehicle with safety concerns. Call Showtime so the team can discuss vehicle movement and the safest intake plan.
